Ku rwego rw’ikigo, ikibazo ni ukumenya niba abarimu ubwabo bashobora gutegura ubwo buryo bwo kugaragaza ubumenyi kandi bakabusuzuma kimwe. Igereranya rigira icyo risobanura iyo uburemere bw’umurimo, ubumenyi abiga bari basanganywe n’ibihe isuzuma ryabereyemo bizwi. Kugumana abarimu babishoboye no guhora bahuza uburyo n’ibihe na byo ni ingenzi: iterambere rishira ubufasha bwo hanze bukimara kurangira ntiriraba ubushobozi bw’ikigo bwo kwikorera. Ibi ni ingingo zitangwa ngo zifashishwe mu isuzuma; si umusaruro SWE yamaze kwerekana.
